doc_friction.issue: No machine-readable report: comparing two runs needed an ad-hoc parser of the markdown misses lists (scratchpad mdiff.py). A --json output would make development diffs one command.

The Bash tool blocks bare `sleep N`; waiting on a background eval needs an until-loop, which then hits the 600 s foreground cap on a ~10 min coda-check run. Starting the eval with run_in_background and waiting for the notification is the path that works.
